metadata.title: Urban Monochromatic Portrait with Bronze Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a sepia-toned subject against a split black-and-white background with metallic bronze display typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist thin-line sans-serif fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle portrait of a male figure in urban attire, rendered in a warm sepia-monochrome. The background is vertically split into stark white on the left and deep black on the right, with the subject's head positioned at the intersection. Typography and iconography are rendered in a consistent bronze-metallic hue on the dark side of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point against the high-contrast split background
Bronze typography balanced against the subject's gaze
Vertical split background creating a dynamic tension between light and dark
Low-angle perspective conveying authority and presence

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose, emphasized by the low-angle shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes to the bronze logo on the right, then down to the display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space on the right side to house the branding elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall; high value contrast between the white background and black clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal tracking for a luxury feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both logo-like initials and full name to maintain brand consistency.
graphicDevices: Ornate crown icon integrated with a central initial

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical, authoritative serif structure and wide spacing.
Provides a similar cinematic and high-contrast serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle, sepia-toned portrait of a man in a black beanie and tank top. The background should be vertically split: pure white on the left and pure black on the right. The man's head should overlap the split.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bronze-colored ornate crown logo and a wide-tracked serif name in all caps on the black side of the background.

verificationChecks: Is the background split vertically into white and black?
Is the portrait rendered in warm sepia tones?
Is the text bronze with wide tracking?
Is the perspective a low-angle shot?

adjustableVariables: Width of the tracking in the typography
Position of the background split line
mustRedesign: Unique facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Consistent bronze metallic color for all graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and pure white background segments
Ensure typography is legible against the black background
Verify the sepia tone is warm and not greenish
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Split B/W Background + Sepia Subject + Bronze Wide-Tracked Serif Typography
